Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her full follow-up damage, so dodge with a minion between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the return, so after dodging the first pass, move clear of its return path too.
Ahri.build: Prioritize a way to interrupt or cleanse Ahri E Charm in case she lands it and follows with a combo. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception, W Fox-Fire, and E Charm, but use health to withstand Orb of Deception’s true damage. If Ahri P Essence Theft’s healing keeps her alive through one combo, buy Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Ahri.fight: Look to engage right after Ahri E Charm is down or while Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable. Hit Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks between abilities to make the most of Diana P Moonsilver Blade’s damage.
Ahri.laning: When dodging Ahri Q Orb of Deception, keep moving clear of its return path as well.
Ahri.combo: A standard trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Don’t use the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark right away; save it as an escape route.
Ahri.escape: Engaging right after Ahri E Charm is down reduces the risk of taking her follow-up combo. After going in, save the reset E Lunar Rush to escape.
Ahri.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two Ability Power items. In the late game, what matters is whether you can get out alive after taking down one target.
Ahri.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after key crowd control like Ahri E Charm is down or an ally has drawn attention first. If you can catch multiple enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush and pull them together with R Moonfall, then use Q Crescent Strike and W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, save the reset E Lunar Rush, take down one damage dealer, and get out.

Akali.watch: Try throwing Diana Q Crescent Strike at Akali W Twilight Shroud during the brief moment Akali is visible as she enters it.
Akali.build: Mix in magic penetration because Akali’s high magic resistance can easily block Diana’s main source of magic damage.
Akali.fight: If just one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is down, watch her remaining mobility tools. In particular, look to engage before her R comes back.
Akali.combo: Hit Akali with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush, land a basic attack, then activate W Pale Cascade. Don’t immediately use the E reset from the Q mark; save it to respond to Akali’s remaining mobility or to get out.
Akali.escape: Especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back, look for a chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush and catch her with R Moonfall.
Akali.phase: Make the most of Diana’s strengths in the mid game once you have at least two Ability Power items. In the late game, judge whether you can get out alive after taking down one target before you engage.
Akali.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on. You can interrupt Akali when she engages on an ally with Diana R Moonfall. Go in after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or an ally has drawn attention first, and look for a chance to pull multiple enemies together with R. If there’s no such opening, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, then get out.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don’t assume you’re safe behind minions; dodge both its outgoing and return paths. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls for movement, so watch whether he uses it when fighting near a wall. If you’re low and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, move behind terrain to block the shots.
Akshan.build: Build armor first because Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance deal mostly physical damage. Basic attacks and attack speed are also central to his damage, so reducing his attack speed can help.
Akshan.fight: Hit Akshan with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush, then trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Right after Akshan uses E Heroic Swing is your chance to close the gap; you can catch him with Diana R Moonfall then. Don’t use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush right away; save it as an escape route.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang can extend after hitting minions, so watch its path even when you’re behind the wave.
Akshan.combo: A standard trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in, so its orbs connect.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. Using Diana E Lunar Rush on the Moonlight mark resets its cooldown, so save the second cast to get out. If you dash in before applying the mark, you may lose your way back out.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, it’s important to get out alive after taking down a target. If you have the Scoundrel mark, don’t face Akshan alone.
Akshan.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of engaging head-on. Target the enemy damage dealers, including Akshan, and go in after an ally has drawn their attention first. Use an opening to pull multiple enemies together with Diana R Moonfall; if there’s no such opening, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one target, then get out. If you have the Scoundrel mark, fight outside Akshan’s finishing range so he can’t revive anyone.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of range. The edges of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam are dangerous, so if you can’t get clear, move in close. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, don’t wait for the slow to wear off; move immediately with Diana E Lunar Rush.
Ambessa.build: If Ambessa’s healing keeps her alive through one combo, buy Morellonomicon. Her main damage is physical, so choose armor when building resistance. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Ambessa.fight: Right after Ambessa uses her abilities and empowered basic attacks, hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once close, make sure all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade hit, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. When Ambessa W Repudiation begins its windup, stop attacking and move out of range.
Ambessa.laning: Poke first with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage when it hits and applies the mark.
Ambessa.combo: Against Ambessa, close in with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack. Don’t use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark right away; save it to chase or get out.
Ambessa.escape: Engage right after Ambessa spends her ability-based dashes and empowered basic attacks. If Ambessa E Lacerate is available, she can slow you and then hit you with the edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, so watch whether she uses it first. After hitting her with the Diana Q Crescent Strike mark, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush and keep the reset Diana E Lunar Rush available as an escape.
Ambessa.phase: Both champions become stronger in the mid game. In the late game, Diana should engage only after considering how she’ll get out after taking down her target.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost stuns along its path and at the detonation point, so don’t just sidestep a little; get outside the blast radius. If you were hit by Q or are inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals increased damage. Don’t fight there; use Diana E Lunar Rush to get out of the storm. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow passages, so fight in open areas.
Anivia.build: Since Anivia’s main damage is magic damage, build magic resistance first. If Anivia P Rebirth keeps you from finishing her with one combo and her healing becomes a problem, use Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Anivia.fight: After landing Q, close in with E and attack, then activate W so its orbs hit the enemy. Engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, and save the E reset from the mark as an escape route.
Anivia.laning: Look for another kill during the window after she has used Rebirth.
Anivia.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate W as soon as you’re close, and weave in basic attacks between abilities to make use of Diana P Moonsilver Blade’s damage.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so when Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. First hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark and reset E. Don’t use the second E right away; save it as an escape route. If Anivia Q hits you, get out instead of fighting through the follow-up Anivia E Frostbite.
Anivia.phase: In the late game, choose an engage that lets you get a kill and make it out alive.
Anivia.teamfight: Start fights in open areas rather than jungle passages, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Engage from the side when Anivia’s key crowd control is down or after an ally draws attention first. If several enemies are grouped, fight with Diana E Lunar Rush → R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, save the reset E and get a kill before disengaging.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, you’ll be stunned and take his follow-up attacks, so keep minions between you and him and move unpredictably.
Amumu.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor to account for the magic damage from Amumu Q Bandage Toss and W Despair. Amumu P Cursed Touch’s true damage cannot be reduced with resistances, and Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your max health, so don’t stack health alone.
Amumu.fight: Engage after dodging Amumu Q Bandage Toss or after Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, and land Diana Q Crescent Strike first.
Amumu.combo: After landing Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush, attack, and activate W Pale Cascade.
Amumu.escape: An Amumu Q Bandage Toss miss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy being down is your chance to engage. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark and close in with E Lunar Rush.
Amumu.phase: In the late game, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush so you can get out alive after securing your target.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, keep your distance from allies instead of grouping with them, and fight in open terrain. Engage from the side when that ability is down or after an ally draws attention first. If you can catch several enemies, use Diana E Lunar Rush → R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade.

Annie.watch: If white light is swirling around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so stay outside her ability range. To avoid the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, don’t stand on top of allies when Annie is out of sight or has her stun ready. After Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay in the area even if you’ve killed Annie.
Annie.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Annie’s damage. Annie R Summon: Tibbers has penetration, so consider movement speed to get out of its area instead of relying on resistance alone. Armor does not help against Annie’s magic damage.
Annie.fight: Pressure Annie as soon as Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used. Hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Annie has no mobility ability, so once you close the gap, you can pull her in with Diana R Moonfall.
Annie.laning: Keep harassing with Diana Q Crescent Strike and look for the moment Annie steps forward.
Annie.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade once you’re close enough for its orbs to hit.
Annie.escape: Engage when Annie P Pyromania’s stun has just been used.
Annie.phase: Mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, is Diana’s peak. In the late game, plan an escape route after securing your target.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie’s stun or Annie R Summon: Tibbers is ready, don’t stand on top of your allies. Engage from the side when Annie’s key crowd control is down or after an ally draws attention first. Look for an angle to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall. If there’s no such opening, save the reset E, get a kill on one damage dealer, and disengage.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your max health, and holding it on you for a long time adds extra damage and Stardust. Stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. When your health is low, also avoid the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you. To avoid Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, keep your distance from allies, especially after Stardust has built up.
AurelionSol.build: Since Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic damage, build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on health alone, and get movement speed to walk out of Aurelion Sol E Singularity.
AurelionSol.fight: Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight being down is your chance to close in. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and weave in basic attacks. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re close so all its orbs detonate.
AurelionSol.laning: Pressure Aurelion Sol hard when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down to disrupt his growth before he builds up Stardust.
AurelionSol.combo: Your basic damage trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t use Diana E Lunar Rush’s reset from the mark right away; wait and see how the situation develops.
AurelionSol.escape: Engaging just after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down lets you take advantage of his lack of mobility. If Aurelion Sol’s crowd control is ready, hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike first, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. Save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark as an escape route.
AurelionSol.phase: Pressure Aurelion Sol early, since he gets stronger as he builds Stardust. Mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, is Diana’s peak. In the late game, focus on getting out alive after securing your target.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage when Aurelion Sol’s key crowd control is down or after an ally draws attention first. If you have an opening to catch several enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, save Diana E Lunar Rush’s reset from the mark and go after one damage dealer.

Azir.watch: Avoid standing in the line attacked by Azir W Arise! soldiers; circle around from the side or behind. If Azir moves his soldiers with Azir Q Conquering Sands, it also slows you, so approach after he uses Q and the soldiers stop. In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock you back and interrupt your engage.
Azir.build: Build ability power items first to boost Diana's magic damage. If you need resistance to withstand Azir's damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of the soldiers' attack range.
Azir.fight: Go for a short burst when Azir's soldiers are still or Azir E Shifting Sands is on cooldown. Mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in on him with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage to use its shield and orb damage.
Azir.combo: For a basic trade, land Diana Q Crescent Strike → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Save the E reset from the mark to chase Azir or escape instead of using it immediately.
Azir.phase: Mid game, when you have at least two ability power items, is Diana's peak, so take short fights before Azir has time to scale. Azir becomes strong in the late game, so plan your exit after securing a takedown before engaging.
Azir.teamfight: Approach from the side in an open area, since engaging head-on in a narrow corridor can get you knocked back by Azir R Emperor's Divide. Engage after Azir's key crowd control is on cooldown or an ally draws his attention first. Look for a chance to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall; if there is no opening, save the reset on E Lunar Rush, take down one carry, then get out.

Aurora.watch: A returning hit from Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again based on the health you have lost. If you are cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and retreat before it returns if your health is low. Once Aurora R Between Worlds is active, leaving its area slows you, so decide before she casts whether to retreat or fight inside.
Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, and Aurora P Spirit Abjuration scales with her maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance over armor or health alone. If you cannot kill Aurora with one combo and her healing is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Aurora.fight: Mark Aurora with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. If Aurora uses Aurora E The Weirding to create distance, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or escape. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Aurora.combo: For a basic trade, land Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Keep basic attacking until Diana R Moonfall deals damage, then use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush to respond to Aurora's movement.
Aurora.escape: Look for an engage when Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are both on cooldown and Aurora R Between Worlds is unavailable. If Aurora has used only one mobility ability, she can still escape with the other, so land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, and save the dash reset.
Aurora.phase: Mid game, when you have at least two ability power items, is Diana's strong point, so look for an opening after Aurora uses her mobility. In the late game, plan your exit after killing Aurora before you engage.
Aurora.teamfight: Engage from the side after Aurora uses her mobility or key crowd control. If several enemies are grouped, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If Aurora gets a takedown, Aurora W Across the Veil's cooldown resets, so don't leave a low-health ally behind as you retreat.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when his abilities hit in succession, then explodes, so it is important to dodge the first Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you are ablaze, move out of the projectile's line or hide behind minions to avoid the stun from Brand Q Sear. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from allies to break its bounce path.
Brand.build: Brand deals magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. Brand P Blaze scales with maximum health, so consider movement speed for dodging telegraphed areas instead of stacking health alone.
Brand.fight: Look to engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame is on cooldown and you are not ablaze. Mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks between abilities to make the most of Diana P Moonsilver Blade's damage.
Brand.laning: Don't last-hit beside burning minions. Move to the side of the wave to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading.
Brand.combo: For a short trade, land Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage so its orbs hit Brand.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the distance with Diana E Lunar Rush when Brand W Pillar of Flame is on cooldown and there is no risk of being stunned by Brand Q Sear. Diana E Lunar Rush's cooldown resets only if you first land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, so don't engage without the mark when you need to be able to disengage.
Brand.phase: Mid game, when you have at least two ability power items, is Diana's peak. In the late game, use the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush carefully so you can escape after killing Brand.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and the chained hits from Brand R Pyroclasm. Engage from the side once the stun threat from Brand Q Sear is gone or an ally draws his attention first. Use Diana R Moonfall when you can pull several enemies together; if there is no opening, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one enemy, then get out.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar's main damage. Briar E Chilling Scream and Briar R Certain Death deal magic damage, so armor cannot block them, and Briar Q Head Rush reduces resistance, so dodging it is the priority. If Briar's healing keeps her alive through one combo, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Briar.fight: Land Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush for a short trade. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage to pop its orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Avoid extended duels while Briar keeps healing, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark so you can get out.
Briar.laning: If you have pushed the lane, establish vision to prepare for Briar's early gank. Don't stay in the middle of the lane for long when you lack vision.
Briar.combo: Mark Briar with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage and get in basic attacks, then pull her in with Diana R Moonfall if you can kill her and survive. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush to respond to Briar's other mobility ability or escape.
Briar.escape: Don't rush in when only Briar Q Head Rush is on cooldown; Briar can still move with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack or Briar R Certain Death. The opening to engage comes after Briar's mobility and crowd control are on cooldown, especially before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Then mark her with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close the distance with Diana E Lunar Rush.
Briar.phase: In the late game, only engage when you can secure a takedown and get out alive.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she attacks the nearest enemy, so have the frontline take her first to protect the backline carries. Engage from the side after Briar's key crowd control is on cooldown or an ally draws her attention first. Look for a chance to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall; otherwise, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, target one carry, then get out.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, move out of range until the poison wears off so you don’t keep taking healing Cassiopeia E Twin Fang hits. Diana E Lunar Rush cannot be used inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so go around without stepping into the cloud. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid being stunned.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, W Miasma, and E Twin Fang all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If you can’t kill Cassiopeia in one combo and healing gets in the way, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Cassiopeia.fight: Don’t force an engage if you’ve been hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast or Cassiopeia W Miasma covers your approach.
Cassiopeia.combo: Engage with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → W Pale Cascade → basic attack → R Moonfall. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade just after closing in so the orbs hit, and save the mark-reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape when needed.
Cassiopeia.escape: Engage when Cassiopeia has used Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere or you can approach without stepping into the cloud. Cassiopeia has no mobility, so hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with E Lunar Rush, and catch her with R Moonfall. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is ready, be prepared to turn away during its cast animation.
Cassiopeia.phase: Mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, is a strong point for Diana. In the late game, Cassiopeia can win teamfights with sustained damage if she isn’t caught, so plan how you’ll get out alive after engaging.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Cut off Cassiopeia’s path from the side, or go in just after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. Engage with Diana E Lunar Rush after your allies draw her attention first or her key crowd control is down, then pull her in with R Moonfall. If you don’t have an angle to pull in multiple enemies, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush and get out.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around its first target, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid being hit by the third missile in a row. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him.
Corki.build: Build armor first against the damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and R Missile Barrage. Armor can’t block damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or W Valkyrie, and resistances can’t reduce the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, so consider your total health as well.
Corki.fight: Don’t force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available; go in just after he uses it. Once you’re on him, detonate all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade and weave basic attacks between abilities.
Corki.laning: If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb hits you and reveals your position as you retreat, immediately create distance.
Corki.combo: Engage with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack.
Corki.escape: Just after Corki uses W Valkyrie is your chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. First hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to secure the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, then engage. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain, so don’t rush your engage.
Corki.teamfight: Approach Corki from the side instead of engaging head-on. Go in after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or your allies draw their attention first. Look for an opportunity to pull in multiple enemies with Diana R Moonfall; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down Corki, then get out.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area. Also move away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder to avoid its stronger second hit. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if he’s low on health.
Ekko.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s main damage. If Diana E Lunar Rush can’t get you out of Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area, consider tenacity first. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing keeps you from killing him in one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Ekko.fight: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade just after closing in so all the orbs hit, and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route. Start the main fight when Ekko W Parallel Convergence misses and Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.laning: Use Diana Q Crescent Strike to create an opening, but if it misses, don’t engage first with Diana E Lunar Rush without the mark.
Ekko.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush based on Ekko’s response and your escape route.
Ekko.escape: Don’t engage just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down; he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Avoid the stun area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then engage with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush while Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If Ekko has just engaged with E Phase Dive, you have a chance to disrupt his movement with Diana R Moonfall.
Ekko.phase: Mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, is Diana’s peak, so look for opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In the late game, check whether you can get out alive after taking someone down before you engage.
Ekko.teamfight: Approach from the side and engage when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or your allies have drawn their attention first. Just after Ekko engages with E Phase Dive, disrupt his movement with Diana R Moonfall. If you have an angle to pull in multiple enemies, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and use R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such angle, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.

Elise.watch: Watch for human-form Elise Q Neurotoxin when you’re at full health, and R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite when your health is low. If Elise transforms with R Spider Form and goes for the finishing blow, be ready to use Diana W Pale Cascade and Diana E Lunar Rush.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Armor is also useful because she deals basic attack damage, and consider tenacity if you’re often hit by Elise E Cocoon. If Elise P Spider Queen’s healing keeps you from finishing her in one combo, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Elise.fight: Hit Elise with the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and weave basic attacks between abilities. Don’t dash in without the mark while Elise E Cocoon is available.
Elise.laning: In the early game, maintain ample vision and don’t overextend to push the lane when Elise is out of sight. Elise E Cocoon hits the first unit it reaches, so stand behind minions. When passing near the jungle, take the route with open vision instead of hugging the wall.
Elise.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade just after closing in so the orbs hit the enemy. Don’t immediately use the mark-reset Diana E Lunar Rush; save it to chase Elise or escape.
Elise.escape: Just after Elise uses Q Venomous Bite, you have a chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. If both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, hit her with the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage. While Elise is airborne with E Rappel, prepare Diana Q Crescent Strike and aim for her landing spot.
Elise.phase: In the late game, check whether you can get out alive after attacking someone before you engage.
Elise.teamfight: Engage the enemy damage dealer from the side after Elise E Cocoon is down or your allies engage first and draw attention. If you can pull in multiple enemies, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and use R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. When targeting just one enemy, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, then get out after attacking.

Evelynn.watch: When Evelynn W Allure’s mark appears, her charm is preparing. Back away before it matures and warn your allies. Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage when you’re low on health, so don’t linger where you have no vision.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage. However, Evelynn W Allure reduces your magic resistance, so backing away before the mark matures takes priority. If Evelynn P Demon Shade’s healing keeps you from finishing her in one combo, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Evelynn.fight: Don’t start a fight while Evelynn W Allure’s mark is maturing; back away. If Evelynn R Last Caress is on cooldown, look for a chance to land Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Use Diana R Moonfall to catch Evelynn only when you can survive after pulling her in.
Evelynn.laning: Prepare a Control Ward and place vision beside the jungle camps where Evelynn could start a fight.
Evelynn.combo: For a basic trade, land Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you get close so the spheres hit, and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark as an escape route.
Evelynn.escape: Back away before Evelynn W Allure’s mark matures, then look for a chance to engage after dodging the charm. Don’t chase just because Evelynn E Whiplash is on cooldown. If Evelynn R Last Caress is on cooldown, land the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush, then catch her with Diana R Moonfall.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after taking down one enemy.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn can dive your backline, so stay within your allies’ vision and consider using Diana R Moonfall to catch her when she dives. When chasing Evelynn, engage from the side after key crowd control is on cooldown or your allies have drawn attention first. If you can’t pull multiple enemies in with Diana R Moonfall, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one enemy, then disengage.

Fiddlesticks.build: If one combo isn’t enough to kill Fiddlesticks and healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest is a problem, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon. Build magic resistance against the damage from Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, W Bountiful Harvest, and E Reap.
Fiddlesticks.fight: After landing Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush and trade with basic attacks and W Pale Cascade. Don’t force an engage while Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or E Reap is available.
Fiddlesticks.laning: You can close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush before Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is available or while it’s on cooldown. Keep vision in the bush behind the lane, and don’t pass close to a stationary Scarecrow Effigy until you’ve checked it.
Fiddlesticks.combo: When targeting one enemy, use Diana Q Crescent Strike → E Lunar Rush → W Pale Cascade → basic attack → R Moonfall. Activate W Pale Cascade right after closing in with E Lunar Rush so the spheres hit. Don’t immediately use the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark; save it as an escape route.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap are both on cooldown, it’s a good time to land the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with E Lunar Rush. Save the reset E Lunar Rush to get out of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm’s range.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Diana is strong in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, choose an engage that lets you get out alive after taking down one enemy.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and don’t group together in narrow passages without vision. Place Control Wards in the bushes and entrances near objectives, and interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm with Diana R Moonfall when you see the cast. Engage from the side after the enemy’s key crowd control is on cooldown, and pull multiple enemies in with Diana R Moonfall.

Fizz.watch: If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available, he can dodge Diana’s engage and escape, so don’t go deep before he uses it. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark explodes.
Fizz.build: The information available isn’t enough to determine a specific item to buy first. Fizz’s main damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Since his damage is concentrated in one combo, dodging the first ability to interrupt it is also important.
Fizz.fight: Land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, basic attack, then activate Diana W Pale Cascade. Counterattack with your saved Diana R Moonfall right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used. Don’t immediately use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark; save it as an escape route.
Fizz.combo: If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is on cooldown, attack with Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack → Diana R Moonfall. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in so the spheres hit. Use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark when you need to chase or disengage.
Fizz.escape: The surest engage window is right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown. Fizz Q Urchin Strike may still be available, so don’t recklessly go deep just because one mobility ability is on cooldown. Land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then use Diana R Moonfall before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back up.
Fizz.phase: In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after taking down one enemy.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay with your allies to make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then attack together once it’s on cooldown. Diana should engage from the side after the enemy’s key crowd control is on cooldown or your allies have drawn attention first. If you can catch multiple enemies, pull them in with Diana R Moonfall; if there’s no opening, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to disengage.

Galio.watch: When you see Galio W Shield of Durand charging, don’t unload your damage; walk out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its tell as he steps back, and avoid the point where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, immediately leave the area.
Galio.build: If Galio builds magic resistance, prioritize magic penetration over stacking more ability power. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Galio’s damage.
Galio.fight: Back away while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, then dodge the taunt and land Diana Q Crescent Strike to engage. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave basic attacks between abilities.
Galio.laning: Poke with Diana Q Crescent Strike and make Galio use his abilities to clear the wave. Once Galio runs low on mana, push the lane to limit his chances to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Galio.combo: For a basic trade, land Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. If you use Diana E Lunar Rush to close in on a marked Galio, don’t immediately use the reset E; save it as an escape route.
Galio.escape: Don’t force an engage with Diana E Lunar Rush while Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt or Galio E Justice Punch’s knock-up is available. Once Galio’s mobility ability is on cooldown, especially before Galio R Hero’s Entrance comes back up, look to apply the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to follow Galio after he retreats or to escape yourself.
Galio.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, engage only after considering an escape route for after you take down one enemy.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero’s Entrance is available, don’t start small skirmishes against Galio’s team in other lanes either. In team fights, approach enemy damage dealers from the side after Galio’s key crowd control is on cooldown or your allies have drawn attention first. If you can pull multiple enemies in, use Diana R Moonfall; if there’s no such opening, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one damage dealer, then disengage.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius. If you’re near the barrel and get hit by Gragas E Body Slam too, you’ll take both abilities, so watch for its range as well. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.
Gragas.build: If Gragas’s healing means one combo won’t kill him, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon. Build magic resistance rather than armor against damage from Gragas Q Barrel Roll, W Drunken Rage, and E Body Slam.
Gragas.fight: Right after Gragas E Body Slam is used, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. When Gragas drinks to use W Drunken Rage, briefly hold your burst and deal it after the effect ends. Once you’re on top of him, pop all the spheres from Diana W Pale Cascade and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Gragas.laning: Don’t stay on top of Gragas Q Barrel Roll, and don’t chase a fleeing Gragas too deep.
Gragas.combo: Mark Gragas with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with E Lunar Rush and activate W Pale Cascade, weaving in basic attacks. If Gragas E Body Slam is down and the damage reduction from Gragas W Drunken Rage has ended, pull him in with R Moonfall. Don’t immediately use the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark; save it for when you need it or as an escape route.
Gragas.escape: Right after Gragas E Body Slam is used, hit Gragas with the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike and go in with E Lunar Rush. Using E Lunar Rush first without a mark leaves you with no way back, so especially avoid doing this while Gragas still has crowd control available. If you get hit by Gragas E Body Slam, don’t counterattack there; retreat outside the barrel’s radius.
Gragas.phase: Gragas’s sustained damage falls off late, but Diana should still consider how she’ll get out alive after taking someone down before going in.
Gragas.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths and unwarded brushes, and don’t let your backline stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. Once Gragas’s key crowd control is down or an ally draws attention first, flank in with Diana E Lunar Rush. If you can catch multiple enemies, pull them together with R Moonfall. If there’s no opening, save the reset E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, then retreat.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits a wall, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow path. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so keep minions or allies between you and him.
Graves.build: Build armor first against Graves’s main damage and prioritize Plated Steelcaps. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen, but it helps reduce his other main sources of damage.
Graves.fight: After hitting Graves with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, basic attack, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade. Counterattack or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots.
Graves.laning: Push or pressure the lane early to limit Graves’s chances to stack Graves E Quickdraw. Take fights in open terrain where you have room to dodge Graves Q End of the Line.
Graves.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in with E Lunar Rush so its spheres hit. Use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark to respond to Graves’s escape or to get out yourself.
Graves.escape: Don’t go in just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Wait until Graves has also used R Collateral Damage, and look especially for an opening before his R comes back. Mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with E Lunar Rush, then pull him in with Diana R Moonfall to prevent his escape.
Graves.phase: In the mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, use Diana’s strength to apply pressure. Graves gets stronger as he stacks, so slow his growth from the early game. In the late game, consider how you’ll get out alive after taking someone down before going in.
Graves.teamfight: Approach from the flank instead of head-on, and if you’re hit by Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area first. Go in after an ally draws attention or the enemy’s engage-stopping ability is used. Pull multiple enemies together with Diana R Moonfall when you can catch them. If there’s no such opening, save the E Lunar Rush reset from Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, target one enemy, then retreat.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge deal his main physical damage, so build armor first. If Hecarim W Spirit of Dread’s healing makes him hard to finish in one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Hecarim.fight: Hit Hecarim with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then use basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade.
Hecarim.combo: After hitting Hecarim with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and basic attack, then activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after reaching him. Don’t immediately use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark; save it to respond to Hecarim’s escape or to get out yourself.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t go in just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Your opening is before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back: hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush, then use Diana R Moonfall to hinder his escape. Save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Hecarim.phase: In the late game, only go in when you have an angle that lets you take someone down and get out alive.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear multiple people, and hinder Hecarim’s movement with Diana R Moonfall when he goes in. Diana should flank after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or an ally draws attention first. Look for an angle to pull multiple enemies together with Diana R Moonfall; if that’s difficult, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one damage dealer, then retreat.

Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment’s eye roots the first enemy who enters, so don’t engage through its path. If you’re hit by the first ability, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on maximum health, so move out of the marked area before it lands.
Hwei.build: After completing your first core item, fit in Quicksilver Sash to remove the root applied right after you engage. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Hwei’s damage. Account for the maximum-health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Hwei.fight: The moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave is your chance to engage. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, weave in basic attacks, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after reaching him. Don’t immediately use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush; save it as a way out.
Hwei.laning: Avoid paths covered by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s eye, and take a wide route around corridors where he has placed an area effect.
Hwei.combo: Your basic trade order is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → approach with Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or escape depending on the situation.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. If you go in while that ability is available, you can be pushed back or rooted. If you mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike before engaging, you can use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset to keep an escape route open.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, watch your timing and remaining Diana E Lunar Rush so you can get out alive after taking Hwei down.
Hwei.teamfight: Approach from the flank rather than head-on, and go in after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used or an ally draws attention first. If you have an angle to catch multiple enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then follow up with Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, target one damage dealer such as Hwei, then escape with the reset Diana E Lunar Rush.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, his allies can follow up immediately, so position with minions or terrain between you and him before it’s cast. If Ivern E Triggerseed is on a target, you can also be hit by the slow after it explodes, so wait for the shield to burst. When Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away to stop the knock-up from repeated attacks.
Ivern.build: Build tenacity early, accounting for Ivern Q Rootcaller’s root and Ivern R Daisy!’s knock-up giving his allies time to join the fight. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor. Movement speed is also useful for escaping Ivern’s telegraphed area attacks.
Ivern.fight: After hitting Ivern with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush and weave in basic attacks between abilities. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on the target, engage after the shield bursts.
Ivern.laning: Get vision in Ivern’s jungle early to track his route as he comes to farm camps. Be wary of newly placed Ivern W Brushmaker, and clear his team’s vision there to remove ambush spots.
Ivern.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Get close enough for the orbs to hit before activating W Pale Cascade, and save the mark-reset E Lunar Rush to escape.
Ivern.escape: The window to engage opens right after Ivern uses his mobility tool, Q Rootcaller. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark, close the gap with E Lunar Rush, then catch him with R Moonfall. Don’t immediately recast the reset E Lunar Rush; save it as an escape route.
Ivern.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two Ability Power items, so use windows when Ivern Q Rootcaller is down. In late game, consider whether you can get out alive after taking someone down before engaging.
Ivern.teamfight: Approach from the side rather than head-on, and engage after key crowd control such as Ivern Q Rootcaller is down or your allies have drawn attention first. Don’t dive onto an ally affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; target them after the shield bursts. If you have an angle to catch several enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with R Moonfall, then follow up with Q Crescent Strike and W Pale Cascade. If you don’t have that angle, save the reset E Lunar Rush, take down one damage dealer, and get out.

JarvanIV.fight: Once you’re in range, trigger the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade and weave basic attacks between abilities.
JarvanIV.combo: Hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then use Diana W Pale Cascade and basic attacks. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in so the orbs hit.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Look for an angle to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall.

Irelia.watch: Don’t engage first with Diana E Lunar Rush while Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is still available. Irelia can close in by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on low-health minions, so keep your distance when minions are close to dying. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear. Leaving the zone through the blades deals extra damage and heavily slows you.
Irelia.build: If Irelia Q Bladesurge’s healing keeps her alive through your combo, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon. The available information isn’t enough to determine your first item or which resistance to build.
Irelia.fight: After hitting Irelia with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Delay your engage if Irelia E Flawless Duet is still available. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in so all the orbs hit, and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia. Back away when minions are close to dying so she can’t chain in with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. If Irelia survives by using Irelia W Defiant Dance or healing with Irelia Q Bladesurge, don’t force a second Diana E Lunar Rush.
Irelia.escape: The window to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush opens right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge. Engage after Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark to escape.
Irelia.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two Ability Power items. In late game, check whether you can get out alive after taking someone down before engaging.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can swing teamfights, so prioritize pressuring Irelia. Diana should avoid engaging head-on and come in from the side after key crowd control such as Irelia E Flawless Duet is down or her allies have drawn attention first. If you can pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall, look for that angle; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one enemy, and get out.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are dodged, and he can stun you when he recasts it, so stop attacking and move out of stun range. Jax can close in with Q Leap Strike, so don’t always use Diana E Lunar Rush to engage; save it as a way out.
Jax.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine your first item. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so avoid building only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike also deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush to trade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in so the orbs hit him, and weave basic attacks between abilities while Counter Strike is down.
Jax.combo: If Jax E Counter Strike is down, engage with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack. If Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop attacking and move out of stun range.
Jax.escape: The chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush comes right after Jax uses Q Leap Strike. Engage after Jax E Counter Strike is also down to avoid the stun while fighting, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Jax.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two Ability Power items. In late game, it’s important to know whether you can get out alive after taking someone down.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike, don’t group up around him; wait for the area stun to end. Right after, use Diana R Moonfall to stop his engage or pull several enemies together. When engaging first as Diana, approach from the side and go in after key crowd control, including Jax E Counter Strike, is down.

Karma.watch: If you keep getting hit by Karma Q Inner Flame, Karma P Gathering Fire brings Karma R Mantra back sooner, so dodge from behind minions or outside its range. If hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, leave the circle before the lingering zone explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance and break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Since most of Karma’s damage is magic, get magic resistance first. If Karma W Focused Resolve’s root is stopping you from engaging, fit Quicksilver Sash in after one core item. If you can’t finish her with a combo because of the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Karma.fight: When Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown or you can dodge its root, hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Right after closing in, activate Diana W Pale Cascade to detonate the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Don’t immediately recast Diana E Lunar Rush reset by the mark; save it to disengage.
Karma.laning: Don’t stay where Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra detonated.
Karma.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use Diana E Lunar Rush reset by the mark last, depending on the situation.
Karma.escape: If you’ve just been shielded by Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, wait for the shield to expire. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance before the root and use Diana E Lunar Rush reset by the mark to disengage.
Karma.phase: In the late game, judge whether you can engage, get a kill, and make it out alive.
Karma.teamfight: Approach from the side rather than head-on, and engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is used or an ally draws attention first. If nearby allies are shielded by Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, hold your burst until the shield expires. If several enemies are grouped, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so watch for its warning and walk away; stand with minions if possible. Karthus W Wall of Pain lowers your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. After killing Karthus, immediately move away from his corpse to avoid Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile while Karthus P Death Defied is active. Keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem after the fight, too.
Karthus.build: Get ability power items that make you stronger in the mid game, but first consider movement speed so you can quickly leave Karthus E Defile’s range and the marked spots of Karthus Q Lay Waste. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor, but stepping into Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces its effectiveness.
Karthus.fight: From a path that avoids Karthus Q Lay Waste and doesn’t cross Karthus W Wall of Pain, hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once in, detonate the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Karthus.laning: Early on, stand with minions to avoid the single-target damage from Karthus Q Lay Waste, and walk away when you see its warning. If your health gets low, consider Karthus R Requiem when deciding whether to recall.
Karthus.combo: Trade with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → approach with Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t immediately use Diana E Lunar Rush reset on the mark; save it to escape Karthus P Death Defied’s attacks.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing ability to create distance, so engage after dodging Karthus W Wall of Pain and leaving the marked spot of Karthus Q Lay Waste. If you use Diana E Lunar Rush on a target marked by Diana Q Crescent Strike, you can escape with the reset Diana E Lunar Rush. After killing Karthus, don’t stay near his corpse, where attacks from Karthus P Death Defied can reach you.
Karthus.phase: Diana is strong in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, plan an escape route before engaging for a kill.
Karthus.teamfight: Karthus can still attack after death with Karthus P Death Defied, so reposition to move away from his corpse immediately after killing him. Don’t force a head-on engage; approach from the side when an ally draws attention first, and don’t stay within Karthus E Defile’s range for long. If you can pull several enemies together, use Diana R Moonfall; if you don’t have that angle, save reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals more damage when you’re isolated, so stay near allies or minions. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, cast Diana Q Crescent Strike along his likely engage path and watch for his reappearance. If he engages with Kha'Zix E Leap, you can stop him with Diana R Moonfall.
Khazix.build: Since Kha'Zix’s main damage is physical, build armor first. However, armor won’t block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. If you can’t kill him with one combo because of the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Khazix.fight: After hitting with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and use basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. The moment after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your chance to counterattack, so close the distance then and catch him with Diana R Moonfall. Save Diana E Lunar Rush reset by the mark as an escape route.
Khazix.laning: Get vision in bushes and watch out for the bonus damage and slow from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Khazix.combo: Your basic damage trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in, and use reset Diana E Lunar Rush when needed.
Khazix.escape: Engage with Diana E Lunar Rush right after Kha'Zix E Leap is used. First mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to reset E’s cooldown, then use the remaining E to chase Kha'Zix or escape. If he disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, wait near your allies for him to reappear.
Khazix.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items, but avoid acting alone if Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In the late game, choose carefully when to use reset Diana E Lunar Rush so you can get a kill and make it out alive.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to prevent the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Kha'Zix dives onto an ally with Kha'Zix E Leap, stop him with Diana R Moonfall. When you get a chance to attack, engage from the side and pull several enemies together with R; if you don’t have that angle, save reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one carry, then disengage.

Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach is dangerous because it slows and knocks you up, so avoid its linear hit path. Kayn can only enter with Kayn R Umbral Trespass after damaging you, so be especially wary of W coming from a distance. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health and also serves as a dash, so don’t chase recklessly while Q is available.
Kayn.build: Build armor first to mitigate the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If you can’t handle the healing from a prolonged fight with Kayn after he transforms into the Darkin Slayer, build resistances first, then reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and look for an opening when Kayn R Umbral Trespass is down. Hit a mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Save the E reset from the mark until you need it to follow Kayn’s remaining mobility or escape.
Kayn.laning: If a warning appears at the edge of a wall where Kayn is, stop trading and retreat toward your turret. Kayn is weak before transforming, so pressure him early to delay his transformation, but don’t give him a kill that speeds it up.
Kayn.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate W right after closing in with E so the orbs hit, and fit in Q and basic attacks where possible before the damage from R lands after pulling the target in.
Kayn.escape: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach; the window before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back is your chance to engage. If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, he may still have another escape, so don’t rush the chase. When an opening comes, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush and use Diana R Moonfall to stop Kayn from disengaging.
Kayn.phase: In the late game, check whether you can get out alive even if you manage to catch Kayn before engaging.
Kayn.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after key crowd control such as Kayn W Blade's Reach is down or your allies have drawn attention first. Look for an angle where Diana R Moonfall can pull in multiple enemies; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush for your escape. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, time Diana R Moonfall to interrupt him as he emerges near the target.

Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread marks you, create distance or break vision so you don’t take repeated hits. The follow-up damage is dangerous at low health, so don’t stay close for long in that state. Kindred can use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows frequently to escape from inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If you can’t finish Kindred with one combo because of the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Kindred.fight: Mark Kindred with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Weave basic attacks between abilities, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade immediately after closing in so all the orbs hit. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to chase Kindred as she escapes or to get away yourself.
Kindred.laning: Secure vision around jungle camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred to slow Kindred’s growth.
Kindred.combo: When targeting one enemy, attack in this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack → Diana R Moonfall. You can also land Diana Q Crescent Strike and basic attacks before the damage from Diana R Moonfall lands. Use your remaining Diana E Lunar Rush based on Kindred’s movement.
Kindred.escape: If only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, Kindred can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t engage recklessly. In particular, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush after hitting Diana Q Crescent Strike before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back. Then pull her in with Diana R Moonfall to hinder her escape.
Kindred.phase: In the late game, keep P Mark of the Kindred stacks in check and only choose engages that let you catch one enemy and get out afterward.
Kindred.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on. If Kindred activates Kindred R Lamb's Respite, enter the zone with low-health allies to survive. At the edge of the zone, look for an angle to pull Kindred outside it with Diana R Moonfall. Use Diana R Moonfall if you can pull in multiple enemies; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to attack a carry and then escape.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs the magic damage from Diana Q Crescent Strike, so poke while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. Don’t dive deep with Diana E Lunar Rush while the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is still active.
Kassadin.build: Kassadin Q Null Sphere, W Nether Blade, and E Force Pulse all deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, so healing reduction is not a priority.
Kassadin.fight: Hit a mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with E Lunar Rush and follow with basic attacks and W Pale Cascade. It’s a better time to engage when Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down or right after he uses R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, so clear waves outside Kassadin’s range where possible.
Kassadin.combo: For a basic damage trade, use Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Don’t immediately use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark; save it as an escape route.
Kassadin.escape: It’s a good time to engage once Kassadin E Force Pulse’s slow is also down. Hit a mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike to reset E Lunar Rush’s cooldown, and use the remaining E Lunar Rush to disengage.
Kassadin.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game when she has two or more ability power items. In the late game, watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk engaging and disengaging, and secure a way out after attacking one target.
Kassadin.teamfight: Diana should engage from the side after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or allies have drawn attention first. If you can pull in multiple enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush and follow with R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If Kassadin uses Kassadin R Riftwalk to get into your backline, Diana R Moonfall can interrupt his engage, but use it only when you can withstand pulling Kassadin toward you.

Leblanc.watch: If you’re marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, the next ability deals more damage, so don’t move forward; retreat until the mark disappears. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you only if the chain stays attached after the initial hit, so use Diana E Lunar Rush as soon as you’re hit to get beyond the chain’s range. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t rush your abilities; follow the one that is actually attacking.
Leblanc.build: Get one ability power core item first. All of LeBlanc’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance instead of armor, and consider a spell shield to block combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice.
Leblanc.fight: Hit LeBlanc with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with E Lunar Rush and follow with basic attacks and W Pale Cascade. It’s easier to continue your counterattack if you go in after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has already been used.
Leblanc.laning: Look for an opening to hit Diana Q Crescent Strike, but if LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, retreat and give the mark time to disappear. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc leaves mid, and secure river vision before moving into a side lane.
Leblanc.combo: Once LeBlanc W Distortion’s return is over, trade in this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade immediately after closing in so the orbs hit, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Leblanc.escape: Bait out LeBlanc W Distortion, then close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush after she has used the return or its duration has expired. Engage when crowd control such as LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down, then pull her in with Diana R Moonfall after closing in. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, prioritize using Diana E Lunar Rush to get beyond the chain’s range before you’re rooted.
Leblanc.phase: In the late game, choose an engage angle that lets you get out alive after killing one enemy.
Leblanc.teamfight: Approach the enemy carries, including LeBlanc, from the side instead of head-on. Engage after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or your allies have drawn attention first. If you can pull in multiple enemies, use Diana E Lunar Rush → R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade; if you don’t have that angle, save the reset E Lunar Rush, target one carry, and then escape.

Lillia.watch: Getting hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed gives her movement speed stacks and sets up Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin, move sideways to avoid the center. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby catches you, move to safety while you still can before falling asleep.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Lillia’s main damage. Lillia Q Blooming Blows’ true damage cannot be reduced by resistance, and stacking health alone also increases the max-health damage from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough. If you cannot kill Lillia in one combo and her healing is a problem, use Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia’s abilities to avoid giving her movement speed stacks, then hit Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once close, activate Diana W Pale Cascade to pop the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Keep the mark-reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape instead of using it immediately.
Lillia.laning: When you don’t know where Lillia is, avoid walking straight through narrow jungle entrances or river passages where it’s hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed.
Lillia.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush based on the situation.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you bait Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is an opportunity to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed as well, so you don’t set up Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, then engage. Once close, you can pull Lillia in with Diana R Moonfall.
Lillia.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game as she builds her second ability power item. In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after killing Lillia.
Lillia.teamfight: Engage from the flank, dodging poke that could set up Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. Go in after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or an ally has drawn attention first. Save one immobilizing crowd control ability so you can catch Lillia if she approaches from the flank. If you can pull in several enemies, use Diana R Moonfall; if there’s no such angle, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.

LeeSin.watch: Be careful where you position, since giving Lee Sin room to flank can let him knock you away from your team with Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If you’re taking basic attacks for a long time, consider an option that reduces attack speed.
LeeSin.fight: Mark Lee Sin with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and weave in basic attacks to make the most of Diana P Moonsilver Blade’s damage. Focus your damage right after Lee Sin uses Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage.
LeeSin.laning: Stand away from walls without vision, since Lee Sin can cross them with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. Keep throwing Diana Q Crescent Strike, but don’t engage first with Diana E Lunar Rush when Lee Sin has no mark on him or his crowd control is still available.
LeeSin.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the mark-reset Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or escape instead of using it immediately.
LeeSin.escape: The window to engage is when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it returns. If only Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down, he may still have another way to move, so check his mobility and crowd control before marking him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engaging with Diana E Lunar Rush. After engaging, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin falls off in the late game, so buy time with objective and lane advantages, and think about your escape route after killing one enemy.
LeeSin.teamfight: Reduce the chance of being knocked away by Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, but keep your distance from allies because you can collide with the target he kicks. Engage from the flank after Lee Sin’s key crowd control is down or an ally has drawn attention first. If you can catch several enemies, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, attack a damage dealer, then escape.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard still pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in line with minions. Be careful not to take damage while rooted by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or stunned by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Since Lissandra can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, spread your finishing damage until after the stasis ends.
Lissandra.build: After your first core item, consider Quicksilver Sash so you can break free from Lissandra W Ring of Frost immediately after engaging. Lissandra’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance instead of armor. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s healing prevents you from finishing her in one combo, use Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Lissandra.fight: Hit Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Weave in basic attacks, then activate Diana W Pale Cascade to hit with all the orbs and make use of the shield. Keep the mark-reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape instead of spending it right away.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it pierces through them.
Lissandra.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread your damage out instead of using it all at once, and wait for the stasis to end.
Lissandra.escape: If Lissandra has already used Lissandra E Glacial Path, she has no escape left, so mark her with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down too, you have a clearer window to fight up close. Pull her in with Diana R Moonfall so she can’t create distance.
Lissandra.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game as she builds her second ability power item. In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after killing one enemy.
Lissandra.teamfight: Avoid engaging head-on. Go in from the flank after key crowd control such as Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down or an ally has drawn attention first. Check whether Lissandra has used Lissandra E Glacial Path, and use Diana R Moonfall if you can pull in several enemies. If there’s no such angle, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, then escape.

Lux.watch: Getting hit by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy to get hit by her follow-up abilities, so bait out Q and dodge it before engaging. Leave the area of Lux E Lucent Singularity, and if you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, keep your distance so she can’t trigger P Illumination with a basic attack. Move sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Build an ability power item for your first core item, then build magic resistance against Lux’s magic damage. Get movement speed too, so you can leave the area of Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: The moment after you bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to engage. Hit Lux with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush, then trade with basic attacks and W Pale Cascade. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so once you’re close, you can pull her in with Diana R Moonfall.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding can pass through the first enemy and hit a second, so don’t stand in line with your allies.
Lux.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Keep the mark-reset E Lunar Rush to chase or escape instead of using it immediately.
Lux.escape: Engage with Diana E Lunar Rush during the window after Lux Q Light Binding misses. While Lux Q is available, don’t use E first without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark, or you’ll lose your way back out.
Lux.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game as she builds her second ability power item. In the late game, go in only after considering your escape route after killing Lux.
Lux.teamfight: Approach Lux from the flank rather than head-on, and engage after Lux Q Light Binding is down or an ally has drawn attention first. Don’t bunch up with allies as you go in, so you aren’t all caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you can catch several enemies, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with R Moonfall, then use Q Crescent Strike and W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such angle, save the reset E to escape.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect jumps to the nearest enemy, so don’t go for a last hit beside that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between the portals and delay your engage until the silence ends.
