Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression cannot be removed with Diana W Pale Cascade or Diana E Lunar Rush.
Malzahar.build: Since Malzahar’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first. You can remove the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp with Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Its damage scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage. Use Diana E Lunar Rush to reach Malzahar after marking him with Q, and weave in basic attacks between abilities to make the most of Diana P Moonsilver Blade’s damage. Save the reset E as an escape route instead of using it right away.
Malzahar.laning: Back away from minions afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions to avoid the spread. If Malzahar pushes the lane, remove his shield with Diana Q Crescent Strike and look for a chance to catch him with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Diana Q Crescent Strike. After hitting him with Q’s mark, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you reach him, and weave in basic attacks while making sure the spheres hit.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Diana E Lunar Rush when Malzahar Q Call of the Void is down and P Void Shift has been removed. Don’t engage alone from an area without vision while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available. If you’re suppressed, remove it with Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar, or have an ally interrupt the cast with immobilizing crowd control.
Malzahar.phase: Midgame, when you have at least two ability power items, is Diana’s peak, so pressure Malzahar. He gets stronger as he stacks up, putting you at a disadvantage as the game goes on, so limit his chances to stack from the start. In the late game, plan an escape route after picking off a target.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is ready, don’t dive in first from the front. Engage from the side after an ally draws attention or key crowd control has been used. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are out, clear them first with an area ability such as Diana Q Crescent Strike. Use Diana R Moonfall when you can pull several enemies together. If you don’t have that angle, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to pick off a damage dealer and escape.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike targets its victim, so you can’t dodge it; stay out of range if you aren’t ready to trade. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don’t use Diana Q Crescent Strike or R Moonfall on the clone that stays in place. Watch which way the real Wukong moves.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage, including Wukong Q Crushing Blow and R Cyclone. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, and E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. If Wukong’s healing keeps him alive through one combo, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong tends to have low magic resistance, so use Diana’s magic damage to trade briefly when he comes close. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks while Diana W Pale Cascade’s spheres hit. Wukong P Stone Skin’s armor and healing build up the longer you fight, so save the reset E Lunar Rush as an escape route instead of spending it right away.
MonkeyKing.laning: If Diana Q Crescent Strike misses, don’t engage with E Lunar Rush without the mark; look for another chance to land Q.
MonkeyKing.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate W Pale Cascade after closing in with E Lunar Rush so all the spheres hit, and save the E Lunar Rush reset from Q’s mark for your escape.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window before Wukong W Warrior Trickster returns is your chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike or R Cyclone is still available, since he can lock you down after you engage. If Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and Diana Q Crescent Strike has marked the real Wukong, engage with E Lunar Rush, then use the reset E to escape.
MonkeyKing.phase: In the late game, choose only engages that let you pick off a target and survive.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while casting Q Alpha Strike, so look for him just after he lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks while it’s active, so avoid staying in a prolonged fight with him. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don’t work, so don’t rely only on Diana R Moonfall’s slow to create distance.
MasterYi.build: Build health as well, since resistance doesn’t reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style. If Master Yi W Meditate’s healing makes him hard to kill with one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
MasterYi.fight: After hitting Master Yi with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you reach him so the spheres hit. Once you’ve made Master Yi use Q Alpha Strike, his landing is your chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush.
MasterYi.combo: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Then activate Diana W Pale Cascade, land basic attacks, and use Diana R Moonfall. Depending on the situation, use the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark to finish him or escape.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after Master Yi uses Q Alpha Strike is your window to engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. First hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark to reset Diana E Lunar Rush, then save the second E Lunar Rush as an escape route.
MasterYi.phase: Diana peaks in the midgame when she has at least two ability power items. Master Yi gets stronger in the late game, so choose engages that let you pick off a target and survive.
MasterYi.teamfight: Don’t cast an ability reflexively when you see Master Yi’s first Q Alpha Strike engage. Look for a chance to catch him with your allies just after he lands. Save crowd control to stop Master Yi W Meditate’s healing, and against Master Yi R Highlander, use Diana R Moonfall’s forced movement instead of relying on its slow. Don’t leave an ally alone to give Master Yi a takedown. Engage from the side and look for an angle to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall.

Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal can reflect Diana Q Crescent Strike, so cast Q after Mel W Rebuttal is down. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if its center hits, so sidestep it, and watch out for the Mel Q Radiant Volley that follows the root. If you’ve been hit by her poke several times, watch out for an execute even if you still have health. After the fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.
Mel.build: After getting one core ability power item, slot in Quicksilver Sash if you keep dying while rooted by Mel E Solar Snare. Mel’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Mel.fight: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal first, then hit Q, close in with E, land basic attacks, and activate W. Save the E reset from the mark as an escape route instead of using it right away.
Mel.laning: Mel has no mobility and is weak before completing her core items, so push the lane or pressure her early to limit her chances to scale.
Mel.combo: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal first, then hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike and follow with E Lunar Rush → W Pale Cascade → basic attacks. Activate W as soon as you reach her so the spheres hit, and land as many basic attacks as possible before R damage comes in.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so engage after Mel E Solar Snare’s root and W Rebuttal are down. Mark her with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with E Lunar Rush; it resets, so save the second E for an escape if things get dangerous.
Mel.phase: Midgame, when you have at least two ability power items, is Diana’s peak. Mel gets stronger as she stacks up Mel R Golden Eclipse, so pressure her early. In the late game, plan an escape route after engaging.
Mel.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of the front, and engage after key crowd control such as Mel E Solar Snare is down or an ally draws attention first. If several enemies are grouped, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush and pull them together with R Moonfall, then use Q Crescent Strike and W Pale Cascade. If you don’t have an angle to pull several enemies together, save the reset E to target one damage dealer and escape.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and travels faster after hitting the first target, making it easier to snare people behind them, so avoid standing in line with your allies. If an unexpected enemy approaches after Neeko disappears from sight, consider that Neeko may have transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour and spread out in advance. Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup may be hidden while she is transformed, so keep your distance as soon as someone whose identity you suspect gets close.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko’s main damage. If you die after being snared by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity. Also consider movement speed to help you leave announced attack areas.
Neeko.fight: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is a good time to engage. After closing in, activate Diana W Pale Cascade and pop all the orbs. Weave basic attacks between abilities to make use of Diana P Moonsilver Blade’s damage.
Neeko.laning: Focus on the real target instead of chasing Neeko W Shapesplitter’s clone.
Neeko.combo: A basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t immediately reuse Diana E Lunar Rush when its mark resets it; save it to chase or disengage.
Neeko.escape: Engage just after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down. To get a reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, hit the mark before going in.
Neeko.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after killing one target.
Neeko.teamfight: If someone approaches who seems to have transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour, spread out from your allies so you aren’t all caught by Neeko R Pop Blossom. Engage the enemy carry from the flank after key crowd control such as Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, or after an ally draws attention first. Use Diana R Moonfall if you can pull several enemies together; otherwise, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush to disengage.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so especially avoid it when Nidalee is far away and keep minions or your allied frontline between you. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack as well; without the hunt mark, it’s easier to stop Nidalee from chasing you. If you’re marked, save Diana R Moonfall for the moment Nidalee comes in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.build: Nidalee’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. If Nidalee’s healing keeps you from killing her in one combo, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Nidalee.fight: After hitting with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, basic attack, then activate Diana W Pale Cascade. You need to be close enough to pop all of Diana W Pale Cascade’s orbs to get another shield. Don’t immediately use Diana E Lunar Rush when the mark resets it; save it as an escape route.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack on jungle entrances and in the river. Clear it first with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability before moving in.
Nidalee.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in with E Lunar Rush. If you can land Diana Q Crescent Strike and basic attacks before Diana R Moonfall deals damage, layer in the damage.
Nidalee.phase: In the late game, engage only after considering whether you can get out alive after killing Nidalee.
Nidalee.teamfight: Look for an angle from the flank, watching where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear, rather than approaching head-on. Go in after the enemy’s key crowd control is used or an ally draws attention first. If you can catch several enemies, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with R Moonfall, then use Q Crescent Strike and W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, save the reset on E Lunar Rush to disengage.

Naafiri.watch: If you’re hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and get the bleed, create distance until it ends to avoid the second dagger. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, so don’t engage just because you cleared the pack. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so try to finish her off after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Build armor first and get health as well to withstand Naafiri’s damage. Magic resistance won’t help against her damage. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate healing make her hard to finish in one combo, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Naafiri.fight: After hitting with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush to start the trade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after getting close to pop the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack, look for a chance to counterattack while clearing it with Diana Q Crescent Strike’s area damage.
Naafiri.laning: If you’re hit by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers the first time, don’t close in right away; back off until the bleed ends.
Naafiri.combo: Don’t immediately use Diana E Lunar Rush when the mark resets it. Use it to follow Naafiri as she escapes or to get out yourself.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down; check whether Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit are also available. In particular, before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is back up, hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark, then go in with Diana E Lunar Rush. If you can withstand the situation, use Diana R Moonfall to disrupt Naafiri’s escape.
Naafiri.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items, but Naafiri’s mid-game roams are also dangerous, so maintain wide vision. In the late game, group with your allies to make it harder for Naafiri to engage, and calculate a way out before Diana goes in.
Naafiri.teamfight: Move with your allies to avoid getting caught alone by Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. If an ally draws attention or the enemy’s key crowd control is used, engage from the flank and pull several champions together with Diana R Moonfall. If there’s no opening to catch several enemies, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, attack one target, then get out.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up. When you see it, move toward the snowball rather than running straight away, and escape through the area Nunu passed. If hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, leave the area immediately to avoid the delayed snare, and don’t stay in range of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero for long.
Nunu.build: If Nunu & Willump Q Consume’s healing makes it hard to finish him, get Morellonomicon early to reduce his healing. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and also consider tenacity if the snowball and snare are a problem.
Nunu.fight: After hitting with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and trade while landing basic attacks and popping Diana W Pale Cascade’s orbs at close range.
Nunu.laning: Stay alert even after one gank, since they can come back again right away.
Nunu.combo: Engage and trade in this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack.
Nunu.escape: The moment Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! passes and you’re out of danger from the snare on Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage is your chance to engage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so hit the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, only choose engages where you can get out alive after killing one target.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, you can interrupt the channel by pulling him with Diana R Moonfall. Engage from the flank after Nunu & Willump’s crowd control is used or an ally draws attention, rather than going in first from the front. Look for an angle where Diana R Moonfall can pull several enemies together; otherwise, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route.

Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with river element, step outside the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall; avoid riverbanks and narrow passages. If she disappears with brush element, move into your allies’ vision.
Qiyana.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and Qiyana E Audacity. You don’t need to build magic resistance solely for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack after Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains in front of you. Mark her with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush right away; save it as an escape.
Qiyana.laning: In lane, don’t stand with your back to a wall; position yourself in an open area.
Qiyana.combo: Hit Qiyana with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark her, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Immediately activate Diana W Pale Cascade and weave in basic attacks to pop the orbs.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t engage just because Qiyana W Terrashape is on cooldown. If you pull her in with Diana R Moonfall during that window, it will be harder for her to escape.
Qiyana.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after Qiyana’s key crowd control is on cooldown or your allies have drawn her attention. Look for an angle to pull in several enemies with Diana R Moonfall, but stay away from your allies and terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn’t hit you all together. If there’s no angle to catch several enemies, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to target one carry and escape.

Poppy.fight: Engage after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is on cooldown. Hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then use Diana E Lunar Rush on the marked target. Weave in basic attacks between abilities and activate Diana W Pale Cascade immediately after closing in. Don’t use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush right away; save it as an escape route.
Poppy.laning: Position yourself in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t knock you into a wall and stun you. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador drops, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.combo: Trade in this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark to chase or escape, depending on the situation.
Poppy.escape: Don’t rush in with Diana E Lunar Rush while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active or Poppy E Heroic Charge is available. Engage during the window after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used and W Steadfast Presence ends, once you’ve landed the Q mark. Save the reset E to escape.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, watch for the right moment to use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush so you can survive after taking someone down.
Poppy.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after Poppy W Steadfast Presence and her key crowd control are on cooldown or your allies have drawn her attention. If you can pull in several enemies, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and follow with R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If there’s no angle to catch several enemies, target one carry and save the reset E Lunar Rush to escape.

Orianna.watch: If you stand near the ball after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves it, Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Position yourself based on the ball’s location rather than Orianna’s. Also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the repeated basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. Orianna’s main damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if you’re buying defensive stats, and get movement speed to leave the ball’s area.
Orianna.fight: There’s an opportunity to trade just after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her. Hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then deal damage with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade while using its shield. Save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Orianna.combo: For a short trade, use this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade immediately after closing in so the orbs hit, and use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush as the situation calls for.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Diana E Lunar Rush when the ball is far away or Orianna R Command: Shockwave is on cooldown. If you’re near the ball and Orianna R Command: Shockwave is available, reposition first. Then land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage, saving the reset Diana E Lunar Rush.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, choose an engage that lets you survive after taking someone down.
Orianna.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after key crowd control such as Orianna R Command: Shockwave is on cooldown or your allies have drawn her attention. If several enemies are grouped, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If there’s no angle to pull in several enemies, target one carry and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you need to attack a target while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, consider percentage penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.fight: Hit Rammus with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade immediately after closing in. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl activates, stop basic attacking and back away; focus your damage as soon as it ends. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is available, first land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then decide whether to engage.
Rammus.laning: Put minions between you and Rammus ahead of time along the path where Rammus Q Powerball may roll.
Rammus.combo: The basic sequence is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Don’t use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark right away; save it as an escape route.
Rammus.escape: Engage when Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is on cooldown. If you’re hit by the taunt, save Diana E Lunar Rush to use as soon as it ends.
Rammus.phase: Mid game, when Diana has completed at least two ability power items, is her power spike. In the late game, focus on surviving after attacking one target.
Rammus.teamfight: When you see Rammus rolling toward you, stay well clear of Rammus R Soaring Slam’s range and move away from the landing spot immediately. After Rammus’s key crowd control is on cooldown or your allies have drawn his attention, engage the enemy carry from the side. Look for an angle to pull in several enemies with Diana R Moonfall; if there isn’t one, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, attack one carry, and escape.

RekSai.watch: Watch most carefully for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. When Rek'Sai goes underground, move toward an open direction and dodge with Diana E Lunar Rush as she emerges. After you are hit by Rek'Sai's ranged poke, stay close to allies because Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow.
RekSai.fight: Hit Rek'Sai with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark her, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush to trade. It's an opportunity to engage if you've dodged the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow or before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back up. Once close, weave in basic attacks between abilities and save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route.
RekSai.laning: Don't push the lane too hard early, and don't move alone where you have no vision. If you spot a tunnel from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near the lane, step on its entrance to destroy it.
RekSai.combo: Trade in this order: hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage so all the orbs hit.
RekSai.phase: Once you have at least two ability power items in the mid game, actively look for opportunities. In the late game, check whether you can survive after engaging.
RekSai.teamfight: Approach from the side rather than head-on, and engage after key crowd control like Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is used or an ally draws attention first. If you can pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall, fight in this order: engage with Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana R Moonfall → Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana W Pale Cascade. If you don't have an angle to catch several enemies, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, then retreat.

Rengar.watch: When Rengar's resource bar is full, his empowered Rengar E Bola Strike roots, and his empowered Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control. Avoid paths near brush when Rengar is out of sight, and don't roam alone while injured when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. If you can't kill him with one combo because of the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is on cooldown. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks while making sure the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade connect.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths near brush when Rengar is out of sight, and use a Control Ward to reveal the brush.
Rengar.combo: Don't use the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush from a mark right away; save it to chase or escape. Rengar's empowered Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so use Diana R Moonfall after Rengar W Battle Roar is on cooldown.
Rengar.escape: Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and engage during the window when Rengar W Battle Roar is on cooldown. After marking him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush so E resets and you have a way out.
Rengar.phase: The mid game, once you have at least two ability power items, is Diana's power spike. In the late game, only choose engages that let you secure a kill and survive.
Rengar.teamfight: When playing in the back line, stay in vision and behind your allies' front line so they take Rengar's leap. After Rengar engages and uses Rengar W Battle Roar, catch him with Diana R Moonfall and counterattack. When attacking, approach from the side and engage after the enemy's key crowd control is used or an ally draws attention first.

Ryze.watch: If you are marked by Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and the damage from Ryze Q Overload is amplified. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux; if it hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears.
Ryze.build: Ryze's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. After your first core item, consider Quicksilver Sash so you can remove the root from Ryze W Rune Prison right after engaging.
Ryze.fight: Hit Ryze with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage. If Ryze E Spell Flux is available, don't dash in first without a mark.
Ryze.combo: Your basic trade is: hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush from a mark to chase Ryze or escape.
Ryze.escape: Ryze's root comes from Ryze W Rune Prison hitting you after Ryze E Spell Flux, so engage after that combo is used. If Ryze casts R Realm Warp, you can interrupt it with the displacement from Diana R Moonfall.
Ryze.phase: In the late game, check whether you can secure a kill on one enemy and survive before engaging.
Ryze.teamfight: Approach Ryze from the side rather than head-on, and engage after the Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison combo is used or an ally draws attention first. If several enemies are grouped together, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If you don't have an angle to catch several enemies, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush to kill one enemy and escape.

Shaco.watch: Watch for the first basic attack Shaco lands from behind with Shaco Q Deceive. If you think Shaco is nearby, keep your back to a wall or face your allies. Watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in unwarded brush and around objectives; when Shaco R Hallucinate's clone dies, back away from the explosion and boxes.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get enough health to avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Also get movement speed to leave areas where danger has been telegraphed.
Shaco.fight: Hit Shaco with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, then trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you engage to detonate the orbs, and save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route. Focus your damage with allies as soon as Shaco appears from Shaco Q Deceive.
Shaco.laning: Keep vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's early ganks and invades. If your health is low, avoid crossing unwarded jungle areas or brush so you can dodge Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Shaco.combo: Your basic trade is: hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush depending on the situation.
Shaco.phase: If you can stall, Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off in the late game, but Diana should also focus on securing a kill and surviving afterward in the late game.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco engages with Shaco Q Deceive and appears, he can't immediately use the same ability to escape, so focus him down with allies at once. Diana should engage from the side after the enemy's key crowd control is used or an ally draws attention first. Look for a chance to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall; if there isn't one, save the reset on Diana E Lunar Rush to escape.

Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault charges and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns you, so dodge to the side when you see their windups. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before the second strike, which deals heavy damage and slows. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from nearby allies’ basic attacks, so immediately create distance as the stacks rise.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Sejuani’s main sources of damage.
Sejuani.fight: Land Diana Q Crescent Strike first, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade just after closing in so all the orbs hit and you benefit from the shield. Don’t rush your engage while Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison are still available.
Sejuani.laning: Create distance if Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath’s second strike or Sejuani E Permafrost stacks become a threat.
Sejuani.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark to use if Sejuani tries to escape, or keep it as an exit route.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after Sejuani uses Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your chance to engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. Check whether Sejuani R Glacial Prison is also down, then engage after landing the Diana Q Crescent Strike mark and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it ends to avoid the follow-up basic attacks.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani grows tougher and better at locking down allies if you give her time, so look for early pressure and objectives. Mid game, once you have at least two Ability Power items, is Diana’s power spike. In late game, engage only after considering how you’ll get out alive after securing a takedown.
Sejuani.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and go in after key crowd control such as Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison is used, or after an ally draws attention first. If several enemies are grouped, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If you don’t have an angle to catch several enemies, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, and get out.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so don’t try to stop her engage; catch her with Diana R Moonfall after she lands. Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on maximum health, and Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explodes when she’s close, so create distance to avoid them.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon’s Descent, and also build armor against her basic attacks. If you can’t kill her in one combo because of the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, get Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Shyvana.fight: When Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty, land Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with E Lunar Rush to start a trade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade just after closing in to hit with the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Don’t use the reset E Lunar Rush right away; save it as an exit route.
Shyvana.laning: Pressure Shyvana before the stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail build up, and don’t engage first if her Fury bar is full.
Shyvana.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate W just after closing in with E, and fit in as many basic attacks as possible before R’s damage lands.
Shyvana.escape: Engage when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is down or her transformation ends and she returns to human form. Apply the mark first with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with E Lunar Rush and save the reset E for your escape. If Shyvana engages with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, use Diana R Moonfall after she lands.
Shyvana.phase: Mid game, once you have at least two Ability Power items, is Diana’s power spike. Pressure Shyvana from early on, since the permanent stacks from Shyvana P Scalemail put you at an increasing disadvantage as the game goes on.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so several allies aren’t hit together by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path, the Shyvana W Inferno Aegis explosion, and Shyvana E Molten Burst. Diana should engage from the side and respond to Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent with R Moonfall after she lands. If you don’t have an angle to pull several enemies together, save the reset E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, and get out.

Skarner.fight: Right after baiting out Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, land Diana Q Crescent Strike and close the distance with E Lunar Rush. Once close, land your basic attacks and all the orbs from W Pale Cascade to deal damage and benefit from the shield. Don’t immediately use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush again; save it as an exit route.
Skarner.laning: Don’t activate Diana W Pale Cascade early from a distance; activate it just after closing in.
Skarner.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark as the situation calls for, either to finish the target or disengage.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner uses E Ixtal’s Impact is your window to go in. Apply the mark first with Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage with E Lunar Rush, saving the reset E as an escape. If Skarner R Impale is available, don’t go deep relying only on Diana E Lunar Rush.
Skarner.phase: Mid game, once you have at least two Ability Power items, is Diana’s power spike, so look for pressure and objectives before Skarner finishes his tank items. In late game, choose engages that let you get out alive after securing a takedown.
Skarner.teamfight: Avoid engaging head-on. Go in from the side after key crowd control such as Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or R Impale is used, or after an ally draws attention first. Look for an opportunity to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall, but don’t use it if pulling Skarner in would leave you unable to survive. Near the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, watch your positioning so Skarner R Impale doesn’t pull you inside.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early to gain movement speed and make it easier to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance first against her main damage, and also get enough total health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, land Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once close, land your basic attacks and all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade to deal damage and gain the shield.
Syndra.laning: Use the movement speed from boots to dodge Syndra’s ground-targeted attacks, and take the opening after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used to engage.
Syndra.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from the mark right away; use it to chase or escape depending on the situation.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so go in right after she uses it. Land the mark with Diana Q Crescent Strike before engaging with Diana E Lunar Rush so you can save the reset dash.
Syndra.phase: In late game, carefully decide whether to use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush so you can get out alive after killing Syndra.
Syndra.teamfight: Avoid engaging head-on. Go in from the side after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used or after an ally draws attention first. Change your engage position if several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are placed in an area, since Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous there. If you can pull several enemies together, use Diana R Moonfall; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape.

Sylas.watch: Against Sylas, don’t use a dash on the first cast of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Use Diana E Lunar Rush to dodge the follow-up chains. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately move out of the crossing point where it explodes a moment later. Don’t delay finishing off a low-health Sylas for long, since Sylas W Kingslayer can heal him for a lot.
Sylas.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine what to buy first. If you can’t kill Sylas with one combo and his healing from Sylas W Kingslayer is a problem, buy Morellonomicon to reduce his healing. When you need resistances, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Sylas.fight: After landing Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, use Diana E Lunar Rush to close in, weave in basic attacks, then cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of him. If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s chains are available, dodge them before engaging.
Sylas.combo: Use this basic trade: hit Diana Q Crescent Strike → engage with Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → cast Diana W Pale Cascade. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of him so the orbs hit the enemy.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct; the window before that ability comes back is your chance to engage. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a dash, so don’t go deep just because Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down. After landing Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, engage with Diana E Lunar Rush so you can save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to get out.
Sylas.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, choose your engages based on whether you can get out alive after killing one target.
Sylas.teamfight: Engage from the side after Sylas’s key crowd control is used, or after an ally draws his attention first. Right after Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, catch him with Diana R Moonfall and focus him down before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Look for an angle to pull several enemies together with Diana R Moonfall, but don’t pull enemies toward you when you can’t survive it.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah can’t change direction while casting Taliyah Q Threaded Volley, so dodge to the side instead of approaching in a straight line. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth lays down a field of rocks, don’t use Diana E Lunar Rush across it.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Diana has a dash, so take care to avoid the field of rocks when engaging.
Taliyah.fight: Land Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark Taliyah, then use Diana E Lunar Rush along a path without rocks from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Once you’re on top of her, weave in basic attacks and detonate all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route.
Taliyah.laning: Back off in advance when Taliyah disappears, since she may interfere in another lane.
Taliyah.combo: Use this basic damage trade: hit Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth has left a field of rocks, check your dash path first.
Taliyah.escape: Look to engage when Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down. If Taliyah R Weaver's Wall hasn’t come back yet, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush and catch her with Diana R Moonfall. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush from landing a mark so you can escape if you’re in danger.
Taliyah.phase: In the late game, only choose engages that let you get out alive after killing Taliyah.
Taliyah.teamfight: Approach from the side rather than head-on, and engage after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are used, or after an ally draws her attention first. If you can pull several enemies together, look for Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana R Moonfall → Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana W Pale Cascade. If you don’t have that angle, engage on Taliyah, attack, then escape with the reset Diana E Lunar Rush.

Talon.watch: Getting hit by both hits of Talon W Rake makes Talon P Blade's End’s follow-up dangerous. If the first hit lands, move out of the return path. When Talon R Shadow Assault is available, account for his stealth and don’t overcommit to chasing.
Talon.build: Early on, buy cheap armor such as Cloth Armor first to reduce Talon’s physical damage. Later, build both armor and health to account for Talon’s flat penetration, and get penetration to cut through high magic resistance. If you can’t kill him in one go because of the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, buy Morellonomicon to reduce his healing.
Talon.fight: Dodge the returning hit from Talon W Rake, then land Diana Q Crescent Strike and go in. Save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush for chasing or disengaging.
Talon.laning: Don’t push the wave and let Talon level up first. If he roams, share his location and ward jungle paths. When it’s safe to push the lane, make him come back to farm.
Talon.combo: Use this basic damage trade: hit Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of him so all the orbs hit, and weave basic attacks between abilities.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. First, land Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark to secure the Diana E Lunar Rush reset. Look to counterattack if Talon R Shadow Assault is also down. If Talon R Shadow Assault is available, don’t chase deep.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence falls off in the late game, so group up to fight, but choose Diana’s engages based on whether you can get out alive afterward.
Talon.teamfight: When Talon dives into your backline, group with your allies and pull him in with Diana R Moonfall to stop his engage. Use it only when you can survive, since it pulls enemies toward Diana. When attacking, engage from the side after the enemy’s key crowd control is used or an ally draws their attention first, then catch several enemies with Diana R Moonfall.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of basic attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is an area poke, so reduce the damage you take by standing behind minions.
TwistedFate.build: The damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and Twisted Fate E Stacked Deck is all magic, so build magic resistance before armor. Also consider movement speed so you can get out of the announced area. Diana’s main magic damage is effective against Twisted Fate’s low magic resistance.
TwistedFate.fight: Don’t engage while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is ready. Right after he uses the card, land Diana Q Crescent Strike and engage. Use Diana E Lunar Rush to close in, cast W Pale Cascade, and weave basic attacks between abilities.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is a good window to close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once you’re on top of him, pull him in with Diana R Moonfall to make it difficult for Twisted Fate to escape.
TwistedFate.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, choose your engages based on whether you can get out alive after killing one target.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Approach from the side rather than head-on, and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used. If several enemies are grouped together, pull them in with Diana E Lunar Rush → R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny teleporting and he’s within range, interrupt his movement with Diana R Moonfall.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, don’t run into the edge. Move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where it will land, so sidestep it. If you’re below half health, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.
Veigar.fight: Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage with E Lunar Rush. Activate W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of him, weave in basic attacks between abilities, and keep moving to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Position behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike can’t hit you and give him stacks. Bait out Veigar E Event Horizon first, then look for an opening to engage.
Veigar.combo: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down, trade with Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush engage → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Activate W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re close enough for the orbs to hit, and save the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so the moment Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. If you’re trapped inside Event Horizon, don’t force your way through the edge; save E Lunar Rush to escape.
Veigar.phase: Later in the game, Veigar’s stacks make it harder to catch him from the same angle, so check his position and whether he has used E Event Horizon before engaging.
Veigar.teamfight: Look for Veigar from the side instead of head-on, and engage after Veigar E Event Horizon is down or an ally draws his attention first. If you can pull in multiple enemies, use Diana E Lunar Rush → R Moonfall → Q Crescent Strike → W Pale Cascade. If there’s no such opening, save the E Lunar Rush reset, pick off one target, and get out.

Udyr.watch: Be wary of the stun on Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first attack right after he activates it. If you’ve been stunned once, retaliate or retreat while that same target can’t be stunned again. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay in range and take hits for long. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so use Diana R Moonfall after the empowerment ends.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s primary damage. Armor won’t stop the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals a mix of both damage types, so avoid relying on a large health boost alone. If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing makes him hard to finish in one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Udyr.fight: Hit Udyr with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and weave in basic attacks between abilities. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of him to detonate all the orbs. Strike when Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield expires or right after he uses Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears for ganks from the jungle, so secure vision on key paths and jungle entrances. Don’t push forward in lane when he’s out of sight.
Udyr.combo: Trade in this order: Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → engage with Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Don’t use the E Lunar Rush reset from the mark right away; save it so you can get out.
Udyr.escape: The moment you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. If you’ve been stunned once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, retaliate or retreat while that same target can’t be stunned again. Since it’s hard to escape on foot, save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset. If you need to stop Udyr’s movement with Diana R Moonfall, use it after his E empowerment ends.
Udyr.phase: Diana hits her peak in the mid game, when she has built at least two ability power items. In the late game, judge whether you can survive after picking off one target before engaging.
Udyr.teamfight: Instead of engaging head-on against Udyr with defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, attack an enemy damage dealer from the side. Engage after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or an ally draws their attention first. Use Diana R Moonfall if you can pull in multiple enemies. If there’s no such opening, save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset, pick off one damage dealer, and get out.

Vi.watch: When you see Vi charging Vi Q Vault Breaker, retreat or sidestep to dodge it. Vi W Denting Blows shreds armor and increases attack speed the more she hits the same target, so don’t fight her for long. Don’t use Diana R Moonfall while Vi is charging at you with Vi R Cease and Desist; wait until she lands and the knock-up ends.
Vi.build: Build armor first since Vi’s primary damage is physical. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health boost alone. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to her damage, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. First hit her with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark her, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush and make a short trade. Save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset as an escape before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up.
Vi.laning: If Vi uses an ability on minions to gain Vi P Blast Shield and then approaches, look for an opening after the shield expires.
Vi.combo: Hit Vi with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush, land a basic attack, and activate Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade after you’re on top of her so all the orbs hit.
Vi.escape: Bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker and engage right after dodging it. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, don’t try to stop her charge with Diana R Moonfall. Use Diana R Moonfall after the knock-up from Vi R Cease and Desist ends, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Vi.phase: Diana hits her peak in the mid game, when she has built at least two ability power items. In the late game, check whether you can survive after picking off one target before engaging.
Vi.teamfight: While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, make sure your backline damage dealers don’t wander out of vision alone and keep them within range of allied protection abilities. Diana should engage from the side after Vi’s key crowd control is down or an ally draws her attention first. Look for an angle to pull in multiple enemies with Diana R Moonfall; if that’s difficult, save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset, pick off one damage dealer, and get out.

Viego.watch: The longer Viego W Spectral Maw is charged, the longer its stun lasts, so sidestep when you see him charging. Interrupt it with Diana R Moonfall when you need to. When your health is low, retreat because you’re an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker deal physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King is a problem in a long duel, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Viego.fight: Hit Viego with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then engage with Diana E Lunar Rush to start trading. If Viego W Spectral Maw is available, don’t rush the engage. Once you’re on top of him, weave in basic attacks while detonating all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade.
Viego.laning: If you see black mist around terrain, don’t push your lane toward it. Avoid the area or place a Control Ward.
Viego.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you’re on top of Viego to detonate the orbs. Use the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark to follow Viego if he retreats or to escape yourself.
Viego.escape: Your chance to engage with Diana E Lunar Rush comes when Viego W Spectral Maw is down and Viego R Heartbreaker hasn’t come back up yet. If only one is down, he can escape with the other, so don’t rush in. Once you’re on top of him, use Diana R Moonfall to interrupt his escape.
Viego.phase: Diana hits her peak in the mid game, when she has built at least two ability power items. In the late game, check whether you can survive after taking down one target before engaging, and back away from unfavorable skirmishes so Viego doesn’t get a takedown.
Viego.teamfight: Engage from the side after the enemy’s key crowd control is down or an ally draws their attention first. Look for an angle to pull in multiple enemies with Diana R Moonfall; otherwise, save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset, attack one damage dealer, and get out. If an ally falls in front of Viego, don’t keep fighting near that spot. Use Diana R Moonfall to stop Viego from reaching the wraith.

Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, don't engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. Look for an opening right after Vex uses the fear on the wave or to harass. If hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your team to absorb the dash.
Vex.build: Vex deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Magic resistance is more effective than armor. Also consider movement speed to dodge Vex's telegraphed attacks and tenacity in case your dashes are disrupted.
Vex.fight: When both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, hit Vex with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade right after engaging and weave in basic attacks, but save the reset E as an escape route.
Vex.escape: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, delay your engage and go in right after Vex uses it. If Vex R Shadow Surge is down, Vex has no mobility for a window, so mark Vex with Diana Q Crescent Strike and approach with E Lunar Rush.
Vex.phase: In the late game, only choose engages that let you get a kill and make it out alive.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with the minion wave; dodge to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, don't continue trading inside it. Leave immediately to avoid the stun. Viktor can gain a shield and movement speed with Q Siphon Power, so account for that even after engaging.
Viktor.build: Viktor tends to have low magic resistance, so build ability power items first to make the most of Diana's magic damage. If you need defense, build magic resistance against the magic damage from Viktor Q Siphon Power, E Hextech Ray, and R Arcane Storm. Also consider movement speed, since it's important not to linger in Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.fight: After hitting Viktor with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, but don't continue the fight inside Viktor W Gravity Field. Don't immediately recast E after the mark resets it; save it as an escape route.
Viktor.laning: Don't stand in line with the minions, so you don't get hit along with the wave by Viktor E Hextech Ray. When the light on Viktor's staff changes color, check his upgrade and reassess the same trade.
Viktor.combo: A standard trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → engage with Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Cast W right after engaging so its orbs hit Viktor.
Viktor.escape: A good window to engage is after Viktor uses W Gravity Field and you get out of its area. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so hit him with the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with E Lunar Rush. Save the E reset from the mark so you can escape if Viktor W Gravity Field blocks the fight again.
Viktor.phase: Mid game, as you build two or more ability power items, is a strong point for Diana, but Viktor also gets stronger as P Glorious Evolution stacks. In the late game, choose fights based on whether you can kill Viktor and make it out alive after engaging.
Viktor.teamfight: Approach Viktor from the flank instead of head-on, and engage after Viktor W Gravity Field is down or an ally has gone in first and drawn attention. Diana R Moonfall is more valuable if you can pull multiple enemies together. If there isn't an opening for that, target Viktor alone and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals and becomes empowered, so don't force a fight while it's empowered. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, use minions as cover or move out of range. If infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you'll take increased damage, so re-engage after the effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Vladimir deals magic damage, so build magic resistance early. If one Diana combo can't outdamage Vladimir's healing, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon. Consider Liandry's Torment if Vladimir has built health.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with E Lunar Rush. Cast W Pale Cascade right after engaging and weave basic attacks between abilities.
Vladimir.laning: When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, use the slow as an opening to engage, or dodge the wave from behind minions.
Vladimir.combo: Use Diana Q Crescent Strike to bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. After the pool ends, hit him with Q Crescent Strike and attack in this order: E Lunar Rush → W Pale Cascade → basic attack → R Moonfall. Don't immediately recast E Lunar Rush after the mark resets it; save it as an escape route.
Vladimir.escape: The window to use Diana R Moonfall is right after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used and ends. After marking Vladimir with Diana Q Crescent Strike, engage with E Lunar Rush so you can use the reset E Lunar Rush to escape. Avoid engaging first with E Lunar Rush without a mark.
Vladimir.phase: Mid game, as you build two or more ability power items, is Diana's peak, so build an advantage before Vladimir scales further. In the late game, only choose engages that let you attack one enemy and make it out alive.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don't group up where multiple allies can be hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague. If infected, engage after the effect ends. Diana should wait on the flank, then dive onto the damage dealers once the enemy's key crowd control and Vladimir W Sanguine Pool are down. Use Diana R Moonfall if you can pull multiple enemies together; if there's no opening for that, escape with the reset E Lunar Rush.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. His basic attacks also deal significant physical damage, so consider armor as well. If his healing makes him hard to kill with one combo, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Warwick.fight: Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then fight again after the fear triggers. Hit Warwick with Diana Q Crescent Strike to apply the mark, then engage with E Lunar Rush and save the reset E Lunar Rush as an escape route. Weave basic attacks between abilities to make use of Diana P Moonsilver Blade's damage.
Warwick.laning: Below half health, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and makes him faster, so when your health is borderline, give up some farming and recall.
Warwick.combo: If Warwick E Primal Howl's fear is down, trade with Diana Q Crescent Strike → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Cast W Pale Cascade right after engaging so its orbs hit the enemy.
Warwick.escape: Don't engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. The opening to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush comes after Warwick R Infinite Duress is down and E Primal Howl's fear has triggered. If you hit Warwick with the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike first, you can save the reset E Lunar Rush for your escape.
Warwick.phase: Mid game, as you build two or more ability power items, is Diana's peak. In the late game, check that Warwick's crowd control is down before engaging, and focus on killing one enemy and making it out alive.
Warwick.teamfight: Warwick R Infinite Duress reaches farther when his movement speed is higher, so watch unwarded bushes and the far side of the pit during objective standoffs. When Warwick's key crowd control is down or an ally has drawn attention first, engage the enemy damage dealers from the flank. If you can pull multiple enemies together with Diana R Moonfall, look for that play; if not, save the reset E Lunar Rush, kill one damage dealer, and get out.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the rear thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If you have been hit by two empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Diana E Lunar Rush to get out of range before the third strike knocks you up. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, account for its knockback and immunity to damage from outside his spear range, then counterattack after it expires.
XinZhao.build: Build armor first to match Xin Zhao’s primary damage. If Xin Zhao P Determination’s healing keeps you from taking him down in one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways, then hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark him and engage. The moment after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge is also an opportunity to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once you are on him, trigger all the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
XinZhao.laning: Don’t use the E reset from the mark right away; save it as an escape route.
XinZhao.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → E Lunar Rush → basic attack → W Pale Cascade. Cast W as soon as you get close with E so the orbs connect.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge is your window to engage with Diana E Lunar Rush. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit is still available, don’t use Diana E Lunar Rush entirely to engage; save it to get out of range. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, look to counterattack when it expires.
XinZhao.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two ability power items, so look for an opening while Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. In late game, surviving after you engage is important; look to act as soon as Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao looks ready to engage, avoid standing too close to your allies to reduce the chance that Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback splits your formation. Diana should enter from the flank after the enemy’s key crowd control is used or an ally draws their attention first. If you don’t have an angle to pull in multiple enemies with Diana R Moonfall, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, target one damage dealer, and get out.

Xerath.watch: If you are hit by the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb, you can take the full follow-up, so don’t engage recklessly while this ability is available. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge sideways. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or, if you can reach him safely, engage on Xerath while he is unable to move.
Xerath.build: First, get a way to remove or break free from the stun of Xerath E Shocking Orb. Xerath’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance if you need defenses, and consider movement speed to get out of the way of his telegraphed attacks.
Xerath.fight: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used, hit Xerath with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark him and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Once you are on him, deal damage with basic attacks and the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade, and use the shield. Don’t immediately recast Diana E Lunar Rush after the mark resets it; save it as an escape route.
Xerath.laning: When you see Xerath charging Q Arcanopulse, dodge sideways while closing the gap on the slowed Xerath. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana poking, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.combo: For a short trade, use Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you get close, and use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or disengage.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your window to engage. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike to mark him, then go in with Diana E Lunar Rush so E resets and you can save it to disengage. If Xerath E Shocking Orb is available, don’t go in first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark.
Xerath.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In late game, make sure you have a way out after taking down one target.
Xerath.teamfight: Approach enemy damage dealers like Xerath from the flank instead of head-on, and engage after key crowd control such as Xerath E Shocking Orb has been used or an ally draws their attention first. If you can catch multiple enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If you don’t have an angle to pull in multiple enemies, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush, take down one damage dealer, and get out.

Zed.watch: Track the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the range of Zed E Shadow Slash cast from the shadow to avoid the slow. If Zed R Death Mark is applied to you, pull him in with Diana R Moonfall to interrupt his combo and prevent him from dealing more damage.
Zed.build: Build armor early to prepare for the main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor won’t stop it, and stacking health alone isn’t the answer.
Zed.fight: Try to trade after Zed uses W Living Shadow, once the shadow disappears or Zed has already changed position. Hit him with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and save the reset E as an escape route.
Zed.combo: Your basic trade is Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade.
Zed.escape: Don’t go deep just because Zed used one W Living Shadow; look for an opening before Zed R Death Mark comes back as well. Then hit Zed with Diana Q Crescent Strike, approach with Diana E Lunar Rush, and use Diana R Moonfall to hinder his escape.
Zed.phase: Both champions are strong in mid game, so it’s important not to give Zed an early advantage. In late game, group with your allies to deny Zed an isolated target, and have Diana think about how to get out alive after taking down one target.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot is an engage that knocks you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt it with Diana R Moonfall. Watch out for the slow and knockup from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and after you absorb his engage, create distance to avoid the percent-max-health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.build: If you can’t kill Zac in one combo and his healing is a problem, consider Morellonomicon first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Zac’s damage, and avoid relying on stacking health because of his percent-max-health damage.
Zac.fight: Hit Zac with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot and his key crowd control are used is your opportunity to engage. During the fight, step on the blobs Zac leaves behind to prevent his healing.
Zac.combo: For an all-in, use Diana Q Crescent Strike hit → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attack → Diana R Moonfall. Cast Diana W Pale Cascade as soon as you get close so the orbs hit, and save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush until you see Zac’s response.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac uses E Elastic Slingshot, his mobility is down, so mark him with Diana Q Crescent Strike and go in with Diana E Lunar Rush. If Zac’s crowd control is still available, wait for him to use it first, and save the Diana E Lunar Rush reset from the mark as an escape route.
Zac.phase: Diana peaks in mid game once she has at least two ability power items, so look for an opening while Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. In late game, check whether you can get out alive after taking down one target before you engage.
Zac.teamfight: When you see Zac charging E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt it with Diana R Moonfall. After Zac engages, create distance to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Diana should enter from the flank after the enemy’s key crowd control is used or an ally draws their attention first. If you can pull in multiple enemies with Diana R Moonfall, look for that angle; otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, stay out of range until the stacks expire. After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so create distance in advance if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so before a team fight, make sure you aren’t alone at the very back of your formation.
Yone.build: The information provided isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so consider both resistances instead of stacking just one. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider movement speed to escape its telegraphed area instead of only building health.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage first with Diana E Lunar Rush if Yone’s tornado is ready or he still has crowd control. After closing in, activate Diana W Pale Cascade to hit him with the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Yone.laning: During this phase, watch the stacks on Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and avoid risky close trades. Look for opportunities to land Diana Q Crescent Strike.
Yone.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after closing in to hit him with the orbs. Save Diana E Lunar Rush, reset by Moonlight, to respond to Yone’s remaining mobility or escape.
Yone.escape: Engage when the stacks on Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado have expired and he has used Yone E Soul Unbound. Yone can chain multiple mobility abilities, so don’t go in just because he used one; in particular, check whether Yone R Fate Sealed is still available. Then land Diana Q Crescent Strike, close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush, and use Diana R Moonfall.
Yone.phase: In the late game, judge whether you can get out alive after taking down one opponent before engaging.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep after a short delay and may be hit by the follow-up attack from Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Dodge the bubble. If it hits, move behind a wall or ally before sleep triggers, and get out of the angle for Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Zoe R Portal Jump always returns her to her starting point, so keep an eye on that spot.
Zoe.build: If you buy a defensive item, consider magic resistance before armor. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces magic resistance and also deals true damage, so dodging the bubble takes priority over stacking more resistance. Movement speed also helps you leave telegraphed attack areas.
Zoe.fight: Mark Zoe with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and weave in basic attacks to deal damage. Engage right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down.
Zoe.laning: Look to mark Zoe with Diana Q Crescent Strike, but don’t use Diana E Lunar Rush first without a mark and lose your means of escape. A trap remains where Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses, so watch out for narrow paths without vision and brush entrances.
Zoe.combo: Use this basic trade: hit Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → basic attack → Diana W Pale Cascade. Activate Diana W Pale Cascade after closing in so the orbs hit the enemy.
Zoe.escape: Close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. You can also engage while Zoe R Portal Jump is unavailable; if she uses it, target the fixed return point. If you engage after landing Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, you can save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush as an escape route.
Zoe.phase: Diana peaks in the mid game, as she builds her second ability power item. In the late game, also calculate your escape route after taking down Zoe.
Zoe.teamfight: Target Zoe from the side rather than head-on, and engage after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down or your allies have drawn her attention. If you can catch several enemies, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall. If there’s no such opening, save your reset Diana E Lunar Rush to take down Zoe and escape.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below’s knock-up and slow are dangerous, so if Bel'Veth closes in, dodge by moving to the side instead of running straight back. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces damage while it’s active, so save Diana’s damaging abilities until it ends.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, so survive it with your total health. If Bel'Veth’s healing means one combo isn’t enough to kill her, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Belveth.fight: Mark Bel'Veth with Diana Q Crescent Strike, close in with Diana E Lunar Rush, and trade with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then focus your damage after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. Don’t use Diana E Lunar Rush immediately after the mark resets it; save it as an escape route.
Belveth.combo: Activate Diana W Pale Cascade right after dashing in so the orbs hit. Focus your damage after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. Use the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or escape.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth’s stacks build permanently, making her stronger over time, so in the late game, consider how you’ll get out alive after engaging.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge when Yasuo approaches. After Yasuo hits you with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, his next tornado knocks you up; watch for the sound and visual effect and dodge it. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks Diana Q Crescent Strike, so go around the wall or save Q until it disappears.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Attack speed reduction slows both Yasuo’s basic attacks and the time until his tornado is ready again.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then trade damage in earnest. Right after Yasuo launches his tornado and the stacks on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest reset, land Diana Q Crescent Strike and close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. After closing in, activate Diana W Pale Cascade to detonate the orbs, and weave in basic attacks between abilities.
Yasuo.combo: Land Diana Q Crescent Strike from an angle Yasuo W Wind Wall can’t block, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush. Use basic attacks, then activate Diana W Pale Cascade to detonate all the orbs.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage right after Yasuo launches his tornado, when the stacks on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t engage just because he used it once. Close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, then trap him with Diana R Moonfall. If you used Diana E Lunar Rush on Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark to reset it, save the remaining dash to escape.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, consider whether you can get out alive after taking down one opponent before engaging.
Yasuo.teamfight: Approach the enemy carry from the side instead of head-on, and engage when their key crowd control is down or your allies have drawn their attention. If you can catch several enemies, go in with Diana E Lunar Rush, pull them together with Diana R Moonfall, then use Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana W Pale Cascade. If there’s no opening to catch several, save your reset Diana E Lunar Rush to take down one carry and escape.

Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability. If it blocks one, Nocturne’s attack speed doubles. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the tether before the fear triggers. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, he can follow the trail it leaves, so change your angle toward an ally or turret as you move.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne’s healing keeps you from killing him in one combo, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Nocturne.fight: Mark Nocturne with Diana Q Crescent Strike, then close in with Diana E Lunar Rush and follow with basic attacks and Diana W Pale Cascade. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is available, don’t immediately recast the reset Diana E Lunar Rush; save it as a way to create distance.
Nocturne.laning: Keep vision on the river and jungle entrances, and decide where you’ll retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, use Diana Q Crescent Strike to pop the shield first. Then hit with Diana Q Crescent Strike again to apply the mark before engaging. After the shield is down, use Diana Q Crescent Strike → Diana E Lunar Rush → Diana W Pale Cascade → basic attacks → Diana R Moonfall. Keep using basic attacks after Diana R Moonfall pulls him in, until it deals damage. Use the remaining Diana E Lunar Rush to chase or disengage.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, he has no way to dash in, so it’s an opportunity to close the gap with Diana E Lunar Rush. Engage when Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down or when you can break the tether. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, pop it first, then use Diana R Moonfall.
Nocturne.phase: Diana is strong in the mid game once she has at least two ability power items. In the late game, judge whether you can get out alive after killing one target before you engage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don’t run off alone; move toward your allies immediately. Check Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness and Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then engage from the flank. If Diana R Moonfall can pull in multiple enemies, look for that angle. Otherwise, save the reset Diana E Lunar Rush to escape after killing one damage dealer.
